title: Perf Baseline
description: Baseline measurement artifact written to .wabblespec/perf/baseline-<timestamp>.json. Reference point for all optimization claims.

platform.description: Platform being measured. e.g. web, api, mobile-ios, cli.

environment.description: Where measurement was taken. e.g. prod-equivalent, staging.

metric.description: Metric name. e.g. p95_latency_ms, lcp_s, memory_mb.

run_count.description: Number of measurement runs. Min 3 for reliable baseline.

paths_measured.description: Code paths or endpoints included in measurement.

preliminary.description: True if baseline does not meet validity criteria (wrong environment, single run, etc.).
